definition.window: c. 1700 onward (first written record 1711; recorded on album from the 1990s)
definition.sound: Afro-Brazilian carnival processional music of Pernambuco: massed rope-tuned alfaia bass drums, snares and a gonguê bell under call-and-response songs (loas) in the urban baque virado of Recife and Olinda nations, and a faster, brass-led baque solto in the rural Mata Norte form.
markers: A wall of heavy alfaia bass drums playing interlocking, syncopated patterns
A clanging gonguê bell and rattling abê shakers riding over the drums
A solo singer answered by a chorus in short, repeated loas
